acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides whether sweep and reap need --lock-wait; if so, it is specified and tested like CAL-V0-216.
body: CAL-V0-216 (PR beamfall/corvint#788, V1-1130) adds --lock-wait to claim, renew, submit, pool acquire, confirm-safe and release, and deliberately leaves out pool sweep and reap, which keep the 30-second default.
title: Decide whether pool sweep and reap take --lock-wait
